newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron drops to 7.50 pesos in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Petron drops to 7.50 pesos in late trade.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp shares shed 60 centavos to 7.50 pesos in late trade on Wednesday on talk of low nine-month earnings, brokers said.
Traders said market talk was that nine-month profits of the country's biggest oil refiner would be affected by its lower margins as a result of an automatic oil price formula.
The formula adjusts monthly oil prices based on Singapore Posted Prices.
Oil companies earlier said that the formula had failed to adequately reflect increases in crude costs from an average of $17 per barrel to $22 this month.
Petron officials were not immediately available for comment. The company has said it will release its nine-month income figures this afternoon.
Some 12.51 million Petron shares changed hands in late trade.
